name: TOML LSP
description: Adds real TOML language support: completion, hover, diagnostics, document symbols, folding, links, rename, semantic tokens and formatting from the Taplo language server running inside the sandboxed Linux rootfs. Ships a bundled TextMate grammar (source.toml) so .toml files are coloured the moment they open, before - or entirely without - the server. Works with Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, config.toml and every other TOML file.
